entries.to: If you or someone you love needs help right now: free crisis lines, text lines and emergency steps, available any time.

blocks.html:
Last Updated: November 1, 2026

Harbor Mind is not a crisis or emergency service, and our phone and email are not monitored around the clock. If you or someone you love is in danger or thinking about suicide, please reach out to one of these free services right away.

If there is an immediate danger, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

Free support, any time

  • 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org. Free, confidential, 24/7.
  • Crisis Text Line: text HOME to 741741 to reach a trained crisis counselor, or visit crisistextline.org.
  • The Trevor Project: crisis support for LGBTQ+ young people at thetrevorproject.org.
  • Veterans: dial 988 and press 1 to reach the Veterans Crisis Line.
  • 211: dial 211 or visit 211.org to find local help with housing, food and counseling.

Local support in Miami-Dade

NAMI Miami-Dade offers free education and support groups for individuals and families.

When the crisis has passed and you’re ready, we’re here to help with ongoing care. Call (305) 555-0142 to book a free consult.
